Model Text Summary:
Set in the Vijayanagara Empire under King Krishnadeva Raya, this narrative highlights the court courtier Tenali Rama. A visiting scholar challenges the court scholars with a silk-wrapped bundle, boasting of unbeatable knowledge. Tenali Rama counters by presenting his own silk bundle, naming its contents 'Tilakashtatishthamahisha'. Baffled and terrified of public defeat, the scholar flees overnight, only to learn that the phrase described simple sesame sticks and buffalo tie-rope.
